sentences: A colossal wave curls like a claw, about to crash over three boats.
Yet the real subject of the picture is not the wave but tiny Mount Fuji in the distance.
Around the age of seventy, Hokusai made a print series showing Fuji from many different places, and this is one of them.
The curve of the wave frames the mountain, setting fragile human beings against nature's force and the eternal peak.
He used imported synthetic Prussian blue boldly to achieve the deep color of the sea.
As a print, it was produced in thousands of impressions, and when it reached Europe it deeply influenced artists such as Monet and Van Gogh.
